snippet.title: Tiles of War - Official Demo Trailer | Steam Next Fest (October 2026)
snippet.description:
Tiles of War – Official Demo Trailer | Steam Next Fest

Command your army. Claim every tile. Outthink your enemy.

Tiles of War is a turn-based tactics game set in a medieval fantasy world where every tile on the battlefield matters. Capture territory to grow your income, recruit stronger troops, and unleash powerful commander abilities to turn the tide of war.

During Steam Next Fest, dive into the free demo and experience the opening campaign - combining story-driven battles with a built-in tutorial that teaches you advanced tactics naturally as you play.

Strategic, Tile-Based Warfare
Every tile can be captured. More land means more gold — and more options.

Meaningful Choices Every Turn
Positioning, economy, unit upkeep, and timing your abilities all matter. There’s no single path to victory.

Unique Commanders & Abilities
Each commander brings game-changing powers that charge as you take damage, rewarding smart risk-taking.

Multiple Game Modes
Play the campaign, jump into skirmish battles, or prepare for competitive multiplayer with Elo ranking.

Play the Demo Soon - Steam Next Fest
Try Tiles of War for free, wishlist it on Steam, and help shape the battlefield.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3395670/Tiles_of_War_Demo/

Wishlist now on Steam and join the battle!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2354240/Tiles_of_War/
